# sherpa-toast

A transient notification (Figma Toast 27:750). The card is NEUTRAL, not status-filled; only the icon badge carries the hue.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Toast |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-toast/sherpa-toast.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-toast/sherpa-toast.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-toast/sherpa-toast.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-toast/sherpa-toast.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-toast/sherpa-toast.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-toast data-status="success" data-heading="Saved" data-value="The record was saved." data-duration="0"></sherpa-toast>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-action` | text |  | an action link label (shown when present; fires toast-action) |
| `data-duration` | text |  | auto-dismiss delay in ms (default 5000; 0 disables) |
| `data-heading` | text |  | the primary line (or the default slot) |
| `data-stacked` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-status` | `info` `success` `warning` `critical` `urgent` | `info` | info \| success \| warning \| critical \| urgent |
| `data-value` | text |  | the supporting detail line (shown when present) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `dismiss()` | Stop the timer, announce, play the leave animation, then remove the node. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `toast-dismiss` |  | On auto or manual dismiss. |
| `toast-action` |  | The action link is clicked. |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | text | the heading content (overrides data-heading) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`action`, `close`, `content`, `heading`, `icon`, `toast`, `value`

`{ action?, heading?, stacked?, value? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
